metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a combination exercise that may give instant neck pain relief.

It will focus on releasing tightness in the upper trapezius (trap) and levator scapulae muscles, big causes of pain and tension headaches.

This exercise can be done at home, requires no equipment, and may give pain relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
